# Article 29: VAT Documentation Generated by an Electronic Fiscal Device
A tax invoice, credit note, or debit note generated by an electronic fiscal device shall contain:
1/ The information specified in Article 19 and 20 of these Regulations, as the case may be;
2/ The unique identifier of the device;
3/ The unique identifier of the tax invoice, credit note, or debit note, as the case may be;
4/ A quick response (QR) code; and
5/ Such other information as may be required by the Tax Authority as specified in a Directive.
